svg.aria-label: Plate V: five-petal bone rosette around a breached-walls rubble vignette with 1495 and 1989 date stamps, de Balsac microtext ring
svg.title: Plate V · Two demolitions: 1495 / 1989
svg.desc: Privately issued banknote plate: a five-petal twin bone lathe rosette; a central vignette of two breached walls — coursed ashlar masonry on the left and prefab concrete panels on the right — above a rubble field and a foundation band reading MONEY WAR 1502, with two seal-framed date stamps 1495 and 1989 overprinting the rosette field; a circular microtext ring reading SUCCESS IN WAR DEPENDS ON HAVING ENOUGH MONEY, DE BALSAC 1502; denomination cartouches V in the four corners.
